sloka: अथ आत्म परिधान अर्थम् सीता कौशेय वासिनी ।समीक्ष्य चीरम् सम्त्रस्ता पृषती वागुराम् इव ॥२-३७-९॥
transliteration: atha ātma paridhāna artham sītā kauśeya vāsinī ।samīkṣya cīram samtrastā pṛṣatī vāgurām iva ॥2-37-9॥

translations.english: Then Sita in silk clothes glanced at the bark robes meant for her to wear and was frightened like a doe seeing a (fowler's) snare.
